scientific_integrity: The mathematical argument is self-contained except standard elementary scalar delay comparison; finite checks support algebra but do not certify an infinite-dimensional theorem.
scientific_limitations: Only positive histories, finite constant maturation delay and h>=exp(-beta*tau). The tail assertion is a logarithmic exponent, not a positive renormalized prefactor. Sharpening is parameter-uniform, not an if-and-only-if condition for each fixed tuple. A plausible 2025 related paper was reviewed only at abstract level.
title: Global predator extinction and its exact logarithmic rate under a sharp handling-time barrier
